description: Vot-ER is a nonpartisan, nonprofit organization working to integrate civic engagement into healthcare.

Water@UW Graduate Student Group
description: Our purpose is to foster connection and communication among graduate students and postdoctoral scholars (“postdocs”) of the University of Wisconsin-Madison water community across disciplines. This group is charged with organizing events to provide opportunities for outreach, professional development, and community engagement.

name: Wealth Management Group
description: The Wisconsin Wealth Management Group helps students explore careers in wealth management by connecting them with professionals and creating opportunities to learn beyond the classroom.

name: Weather Watchers
description: To publish a daily weather newsletter and improve the quality of life at the University of Wisconsin Law School.

name: Wheelhouse Studios
description: To enrich the UW-Madison campus and broader Madison community by cultivating an accessible, inclusive creative home that offers free drop-in art opportunities, diverse hands-on instruction, and open studio spaces where creators of all skill levels can explore, connect, and thrive. Wheelhouse Studios is an open art studio in Madison, located in the lower level of Memorial Union. With three versatile workspaces, flexible studio designs, drop-in art opportunities, and classes for enthusiasts and first-time artists alike, it’s easy to engage in the arts at Wheelhouse. name: Wildlife Disease Association, UW-Madison Student Chapter
description: Our mission is to introduce UW-Madison students to the world of wildlife and disease through opportunities in disease identification, career exploration, and exciting new adventures within the Madison area.

name: WiscoHumanoids
description: To bring Humanoid Robotics to Madison

name: Wisconsin Aerospace
description: Wisconsin Aerospace provides students with hands-on aerospace engineering experience through the design, manufacturing, testing, and competition of a radio-controlled aircraft. Our mission is to foster technical excellence, innovation, and teamwork while developing the next generation of engineers through collaborative, real-world design challenges.

name: Wisconsin Alpine Ski and Snowboard Team
description: The mission of the Wisconsin Alpine Ski and Snowboard Team is to foster a competitive, inclusive, and supportive environment where students develop confidence as athletes, leadership skills, and lasting friendships through alpine ski and snowboard racing. We strive to create an environment that promotes athletic excellence, personal growth, teamwork and sportsmanship.

name: Wisconsin Asian Business Association
description: The Wisconsin Asian Business Society (WABA) aims to create a shared community helping Asian American students navigate and succeed in the business world and find a family of people with similar backgrounds and interests.

name: Wisconsin Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers - Student Chapter
description: The Wisconsin Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers - Student Chapter (WACDLS) is committed to promoting the proper administration of criminal justice, fostering and maintaining integrity, independence and expertise of criminal defense lawyers, and promoting the protection of individual rights and due process. We are affiliated with the professional chapter and provide a mentorship program with criminal defense attorneys in the Madison community.

name: Wisconsin Autonomous
description: Wisconsin Autonomous brings together students from across disciplines to design, build, and test advanced vehicle technologies. Through hands-on engineering, teamwork, and competition, we prepare students to solve real-world mobility challenges.

name: Wisconsin Autonomous Underwater Vehicles
description: Wisconsin Autonomous Underwater Vehicles shall facilitate hands-on learning outside of the classroom while developing technical, collaborative, and leadership skills through the development of underwater robotic systems.

name: Wisconsin Boxing Club
description: Our mission is to bring students together teaching them how to box safely and providing an environment where they can build their boxing skills as a community.

name: Wisconsin Business Review
description: At its core, the Wisconsin Business Review is more than a publication; it is a dynamic platform that empowers students to engage in high-level research, foster collaboration across diverse backgrounds, and articulate their perspectives with conviction. Through our committee-style structure, our members have engaged in respectful, intellectually rigorous debate, challenging one another to elevate their analytical capabilities.

name: Wisconsin Competitive Cheer Club
description: Providing college students with a structured environment to begin or continue competing, performing, and advancing their cheerleading skill sets throughout their higher education years. Improve communication through a positive environment and uplifiting spirits.

name: Wisconsin Consulting Club
description: The Wisconsin Consulting Club is driven to prove that the University of Wisconsin-Madison is an elite recruiting ground for consulting firms. Our intelligence and passion, structured approach to personal development, and the strength of our networks drive continued high performance by club members and lays the framework for their successful careers in the consulting industry.

name: Wisconsin Engineer Magazine
description: The mission of the Wisconsin Engineering Magazine is to function as an entirely student- run publication that creates an informative, professional, and engaging magazine and website that focus on engineering, science and technology topics relating to and intended for the University of Wisconsin-Madison community.

name: Wisconsin Entrepreneurship Hub
description: The Wisconsin Entrepreneurship Hub (WEH) is the organizing entity providing leadership to help the university community form an increasingly greater number of companies of all types than it does currently. Our culture is founder-first, collaborative, and university-wide. We measure our success by the success of founders, the companies they form, and the strength of the broader entrepreneurship ecosystem. Business formation is aligned with a central value of our university, the Wisconsin Idea.

name: Wisconsin Equestrian Team
description: - Empowers students to grow their horsemanship skills, while also balancing academics and improving student mental and physical wellbeing.

name: Wisconsin Gymnastics Club
description: The purpose of the Wisconsin Gymnastics Club is to provide an opportunity for students to practice and compete in the sport of gymnastics. The secondary, but equally important, purpose of the club is to provide a safe and open environment to establish relationships and build a community.

name: Wisconsin Homecoming Committee
description: The mission of the Wisconsin Homecoming Committee is to bring together the Badger community by providing opportunities to honor Wisconsin tradition. Empowered by UW–Madison Student Affairs, the Homecoming Committee reaches out to the student body, alumni, and community to celebrate what it means to be a Wisconsin Badger.

name: Wisconsin Hoofer Sailing Cub
description: Established in 1939, is a community of students and members dedicated to promoting recreational and competitive sailing at the University of Wisconsin-Madison. We provide the organization, equipment, infrastructure, instruction, and financing necessary to make sailing accessible to everyone. Membership includes unlimited lessons and access to one of the largest fleets in the nation, featuring dinghies, keelboats, windsurfing equipment, and winter kiting gear. We encourage all members to volunteer, become instructors, and get involved in club leadership. By doing the work ourselves, we keep mem

name: Wisconsin Hoofers
description: The Wisconsin Hoofers is the premier outdoors club at the University of Wisconsin-Madison. With nearly 2,000 members, Hoofers is one of the oldest and largest student organization on campus. From sailing on Lake Mendota to climbing at Devil’s Lake, Hoofers is a place where people of all abilities can learn outdoor skills and enjoy outdoor activities. Hoofers is proud to be part of the Wisconsin Union Directorate, the student programming and leadership board for the Wisconsin Union. Get outside with us and hoof on! The Wisconsin Hoofers is the premier outdoors club at the University of Wisconsi

name: Wisconsin Hoofers Mountaineering Club
description: The Hoofer Mountaineering Club is a student-run organization that wants to keep people out on the rocks, while also maintaining a collective of knowledgeable climbers who can both learn from and teach one another. We love teaching new members and we love getting people together to go out and climb as a community, whether it be at the classic Devil's Lake or as far as Spain! We run both club trips and more relaxed unofficial trips for last-minute planners. If you're more experienced, if you're looking to improve or to even just get started, we also offer a climbing team!

name: Wisconsin Hoofers Outing Club
description: The Hoofer Outing Club is an outdoors education and recreation club with a diverse membership of students, faculty, staff, and community members. Members plan and lead trips in Wisconsin and around the country, instruct lessons, oversee purchase and upkeep of club equipment, and coordinate all aspects of club operations. When you join the Outing Club, lessons are free and most equipment use is included; trip costs are usually only gas, food, and camping expenses. You can join in on a trip or lead one yourself! Trips are announced on the website calendar, through our email list, or at one of ou

name: Wisconsin Hoofers Riding Club
description: The Hoofer Riding Club's mission is to foster horsemanship, inspire leadership, and create community through equine education. Our values are horsemanship, human & horse compassion, education, and dedication. We strive to provide fun and affordable horsemanship opportunities for students of all ages.

name: Wisconsin Hoofers Scuba Club
description: The Hoofer Scuba Club at UW-Madison is your gateway to exploring the underwater world. Whether you're a seasoned diver or looking to take your first plunge, our club offers a supportive and adventurous community passionate about scuba diving and marine exploration.

name: Wisconsin International Law Journal
description: The Wisconsin International Law Journal (WILJ) (est. 1982) offers articles of scholarly and practical interest in various areas of international law. Articles are written by both professionals in the field and by law students. Student members of WILJ edit articles of interest in various areas of international law and draft articles for submission and possible publication. WILJ publishes three to four issues each year.

name: Wisconsin International Studies Major Association
description: By establishing and maintaining a strong sense of community, the Wisconsin International Studies Major Association aims to create a network of fellow Badgers with a passion for international affairs. We invite current International Studies Majors and International Relations Alumni, as well as professionals in internationally related fields, to join, reconnect, network, and share their professional experiences with current undergraduates. In addition, WISMA aims to enhance the undergraduate experience of current WISMA members by fostering relationships amongst members and providing them with st

name: Wisconsin Journal of Law, Gender & Society
Wisconsin Law Review
description: The Wisconsin Law Review advances thoughtful and rigorous legal scholarship by publishing high-quality analysis and commentary on issues of local, state, national, and international significance. As a student-run journal at the University of Wisconsin Law School, we serve judges, practitioners, scholars, students, and policymakers by fostering meaningful dialogue on contemporary legal issues and contributing to the development of the law through excellence in editing, publication, and professional collaboration.

name: Wisconsin Marathon Team
description: The Wisconsin Marathon Team (WMT) is dedicated to fostering a supportive and welcoming running environment on campus for members of all skill levels and running backgrounds. By providing training plans, well-being resources, and hosting weekly practices, we aim to build a space where anyone, regardless of running experience, can come to meet new people, train for races (of any distance, not just marathons), and engage in the countless physical and mental health benefits that running provides.

name: Wisconsin Marketing Organization
description: The Wisconsin Marketing Organization connects UW-Madison students with local Madison businesses for hands-on marketing experience while helping those businesses grow. Members work in small teams on live client projects led by student project managers, covering brand strategy, content creation, social media, market research, and campaign execution. We are open to students of all majors and all experience levels, and we teach the fundamentals before members ever touch client work.

name: Wisconsin Medical Society-Medical Student Section University of Wisconsin School of Medicine and Public Health Chapter
Wisconsin MEDLIFE
description: MEDLIFE is a national organization that partners with low-income communities in Latin America, Africa, and India to improve their access to medicine, education, and community development initiatives. The Wisconsin chapter empowers college students to instigate tangible change both locally and globally. Our chapter consists of all majors including biology, accounting, engineering, and more! All students are welcome and wanted here for MEDLIFE. A helping hand is out of joy and love.

name: Wisconsin Model United Nations
description: Wisconsin Model United Nations, or WiscoMUN, is a premier Model United Nations club located at the University of Wisconsin-Madison. WiscoMUN offers UW-Madison students the opportunity to expand their understanding of international institutions while also developing their skills in public speaking, debate, diplomacy, research, and critical thinking. Club members have the option to travel with WiscoMUN to various collegiate Model United Nations conferences, such as HNMUN, McMUN, and CHOMUN, where they can win awards and build connections with like-minded students from other universities. WiscoMU

name: Wisconsin Neuromorphic Computing and NeuroAI Lab
Wisconsin Open Hardware
description: Bridging the gap between classroom theory and industry practice by empowering undergraduates with a collaborative, peer-led environment to design, verify, and build industry-grade hardware from scratch.

name: Wisconsin Organization of Furries
description: The Wisconsin Organization of Furries is a gathering of Madison-area students interested in furries and furry culture. The purpose of this group is to encourage creativity and socialization among those with common interest, as well as provide a place for freedom of self-expression.

name: Wisconsin Pickleball Club
description: The Wisconsin Pickleball Club is dedicated to fostering a competitive and supportive community for UW–Madison students who are passionate about pickleball. Through structured practices, tournament competition, and team events, we help members develop their skills, compete at a high level, and grow as athletes and teammates. We strive to build a team culture that values hard work, continuous improvement, and a strong sense of community both on and off the court.

name: Wisconsin Pre-Medical Society, UW–Madison
description: We aim to help students expand their knowledge of what a healthcare career can look like by providing them with opportunities to interact with physicians and their community.

name: Wisconsin Private Equity Club
description: The Wisconsin Private Equity Club’s mission is to educate and develop undergraduate students interested in private equity and alternative investments through experiential learning, industry exposure, and professional development

name: Wisconsin Public Interest Law Foundation, Inc.
Wisconsin Quadball
description: Our mission is to provide a space for UW-Madison students to learn, practice and play Quadball under the US Quadball league.

name: Wisconsin Racing Formula SAE
description: The Formula SAE Racing team is a student group, consisting primarily of engineers, as well as business and art students, dedicated to the design, fabrication, marketing, and racing of a small open-wheel race car for a Society of Automotive Engineers (SAE) sponsored competition. The team’s purpose is to be a technical organization devoted to the fostering of strong engineering principles and ideas through real-world experiences and practices. The intent is to run the team not as a social student organization but as a small engineering firm.

name: Wisconsin Robotics
description: Wisconsin Robotics shall facilitate hands-on learning outside of the classroom while developing technical, collaborative, and leadership skills through the development of robotic systems. Wisconsin Robotics shall, through the usage and demonstration of robotic systems, inspire pre-collegiate students to attend college and pursue a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) career.

name: Wisconsin Ski and Snowboard Club
description: The Hoofer Ski and Snowboard Club brings UW–Madison students together to enjoy skiing, snowboarding, adventure, and community. The club welcomes everyone from beginners to experienced riders, offering opportunities to learn, explore, compete, and make new friends. Members can participate in weekly trips to local ski areas such as Tyrol Basin, as well as travel to renowned resorts throughout Colorado, Utah, Wyoming, and beyond. Optional lessons help members develop their skills, while the club’s Alpine, Freestyle, and Nordic teams provide opportunities for those interested in competition and co

name: Wisconsin SmallSat
description: The mission of Wisconsin SmallSat (WiS³) is to provide students at the University of Wisconsin-Madison with hands-on experience in aerospace engineering, satellite systems, instrumentation, and systems engineering through structured, competition-driven projects. WiS³ exists to bridge theoretical coursework and real-world engineering practice by engaging members in the full lifecycle of aerospace systems, including requirements definition, design, fabrication, testing, flight operations, and post-mission analysis.

name: Wisconsin Society for Conservation Biology Student Chapter
Wisconsin Society of Pharmacy Students
description: The purpose of the Society is to advance the profession of pharmacy. We advance the profession of pharmacy in many different ways, which makes the Society a multifaceted organization. In general, the Society attempts to advance the profession of pharmacy by educating student pharmacists, educating the public, providing unique opportunities for student pharmacists, and providing services to the public that feature student pharmacists. Involvement in the Society also provides many opportunities through association with other student pharmacists within UW-Madison.

name: Wisconsin Space Program
description: Provide students with the opportunity to learn about rocketry as part of national collegiate competitions and academic aerospace research.

name: Wisconsin Sports Business Conference
description: Leveraging Badger talent and alumni, the WSBC seeks to provide a platform for emerging sports business leaders to connect with established industry professionals, gain critical industry insights, and engage with premier recruitment opportunities in the sports business world.

name: Wisconsin Tech Consulting
description: Wisconsin Tech Consulting provides high-quality technology and software consulting services on a pro-bono basis to nonprofit organizations, businesses, student groups, and community partners who lack the resources to obtain them, while developing our members' technical, professional, and leadership skills. We exist to bridge classroom learning with real-world application, and to serve our community and prepare students for careers in tech consulting.

name: Wisconsin Track Club
description: Our mission is to promote and encourage interest and participation in track and field sports, and to promote, support and encourage track and field athletic and running contests for all age groups so as to better the physical and moral welfare of the people of the State of Wisconsin. We also aim to support the mission of University Recreation and Wellbeing and the Club Sports program at the university.

name: Wisconsin Triathlon Team
description: Make triathlon as a sport more accessible ranging from nationally ranked athletes to first time racers. We also strive make the racing experience fun for everyone. That means cheering on every athlete that you can, engaging with other teams, and just generally bringing good vibes to competitions. We also want to give back to the athletic community by volunteering at local races, such as, IRONMAN and the Madison Marathon. But most importantly we want to provide an amazing group for support and friends for UW students.

name: Wisconsin Undergraduate Business Council
description: The Wisconsin Undergraduate Business Council (UBC) is the official undergraduate student government of the Wisconsin School of Business, supporting students by connecting them to faculty and administration, fostering an uplifting and inclusive educational environment, and promoting resources for professional development, philanthropy, personal growth, mental health, diversity and inclusion, and student involvement.

name: Wisconsin Undergraduate Law Review
description: The organization is designed to be a forum for ideas and learning. Free from preconceived judgments on ideals or perspective, students should feel the freedom to discover themselves and their possible love for law. However, The Wisconsin Undergraduate Law Review is not just for students interested in practicing law, it is for students who understand that the U.S. legal system and the laws that it produces will impact us every day for the rest of our lives. Through research, discussion, editing, and publishing we will provide a space for discovery.

name: Wisconsin Union Directorate
description: The mission of the Wisconsin Union Directorate (WUD) is to provide impactful and purposeful programming throughout Wisconsin Union spaces. Ensuring events are 100% planned and led by students, for students. Creating spaces at the Union for students to connect with peers, grow in their leadership, and positively impact our campus community.

name: Wisconsin Union Directorate Society & Politics Committee
description: The WUD Society and Politics (SoPo) Committee develops and implements informative programs that address contemporary issues and stimulate political and social discussions within the university community. This may be achieved through a variety of program formats including but not limited to lectures, debates, panels, forums, and discussion groups. The nonpartisan committee focuses on current social and political issues that have a campus, local, domestic, and/or international impact. Past programs have included political debates, candidate appearances, panel discussions, weekly discussions, ser

name: Wisconsin Union Theater
description: As the premier performing arts presenter at the University of Wisconsin–Madison, the Wisconsin Union Theater brings extraordinary music, dance, and theater to life while serving as a learning lab for student leaders. Through the Wisconsin Union Directorate, students gain hands-on experience in artistic curation, artist services, and event promotion with mentorship from professional staff. WUT also welcomes university departments, student organizations, and the greater Madison community, who rent our venues for performances, symposiums, graduations, and conferences. WUT also operates Campus Art

name: Wisconsin Vira
description: Wisconsin Vira exists to give UW-Madison students a home for Indian classical dance – whether they're continuing years of training or discovering it for the first time. We build a stage-performance community rooted in joy, energy, and hope, where dancers' mental health, wellbeing, and independence come first. Through performance, we share Indian classical dance with the UW-Madison community while creating a space where every member feels supported both on and off stage.

name: Wisconsin Water Ski and Wakeboard
description: The purpose of the Wisconsin Water Ski and Wakeboard Team shall be to promote the sport of water skiing and wakeboarding through group participation and associated recreational activities for the mutual benefit of the members and the public; to develop and maintain facilities for water skiing; to stimulate interest in water skiing among non-skiers; and to work for greater safety among water skiers.

name: Wisconsin Watercolors
description: Wisconsin Watercolors aims to create a fun "drop your backpacks for an hour and paint!" atmosphere where students can connect with others, explore the watercoloring art process, and enjoy watercoloring as a meaningful creative outlet. This organization seeks to make watercolor accessible to students of all experience levels while creating opportunities to enjoy art in fun and unconventional settings around campus. Beyond UW-Madison, Wisconsin Watercolors hopes to use art as a way to connect with and give back to the Madison community by creating with and for local organizations. Ultimately, Wi

name: Wisconsin Women Pre-Med Association
description: The mission of WWPA is to provide opportunities to undergraduates who aspire to be in the medical field. This organization will provide information about applying to graduate-level programs in the medical field, improving applications, volunteering opportunities, shadowing opportunities, research opportunities, and academic support within a close-knit group.

name: Wisconsin Women Writer's Society
description: Wisconsin Women Writer’s Society is an organization at UW-Madison that focuses on extracurricular writing and creating a low-pressure space for students to get together to share their creative work. It primarily encourages narratives relating to women’s empowerment. This will be a dedicated space for students to explore different writing styles, workshop, and peer review within a supportive community.

name: Wisconsin Women's Club Lacrosse
description: To provide a fun and welcoming environment for self-identifying women to play lacrosse, while competing against various teams from all over the country.

name: Wisconsin Women's Ultimate
description: To introduce women and non-binary individuals to a competitive sport that emphasizes Spirit of the Game, teamwork, a willingness to learn and a community that finds joy in competitive ultimate. To further the knowledge of ultimate at UW-Madison and in the city in general, thereby increasing the skill-level and competitive ability of each individual. This, in turn, will aid in elevating the level of college women’s ultimate across the United States.

name: WiscWind
description: This multi-disciplinary team of students competes in the Collegiate Wind Competition put on by the U.S. Department of Energy in which they design a functioning wind turbine prototype and create a project development plan for a hypothetical wind farm. Through this process, they aim to learn practical design, fabrication, siting, and planning skills as well as form professional relationships with companies in the wind and related industries.

name: Women Impacting Supply Chain Excellence, UW-Madison
description: The purpose of our organization is to bring together University of Wisconsin-Madison students who are interested in or currently majoring in supply chain management, with the primary purpose of promoting the field of supply chain management logistics.

name: Women in Business
description: Women in Business at the University of Wisconsin-Madison empowers members through a community built on inclusion, mentorship, and collaboration. We develop well‑rounded leaders by fostering personal and professional growth and creating spaces where every member can learn, lead, and thrive.

name: Women in Business Technology
description: Women in Business Technology introduces undergraduate women to careers on the business side of the technology industry, creates lasting partnerships between members and professionals, and connects driven students with companies seeking talent in the business technology industry. We accomplish this through networking opportunities, including guest speaker events, mentorship programs, and an annual business trek to Chicago.

name: Women in Economics
description: Women in Economics (WE) is a women-lead student organization that strives to promote awareness of gender disparities and barriers within the field of economics, and to educate and improve the community through outreach, mentorship, and by facilitating conversations among women in the field at all levels.

name: Women in Electrical and Computer Engineering
description: Women in Electrical and Computer Engineering (WECE)'s purpose is to bring together and support women and underrepresented genders within the majors of Electrical and Computer Engineering. WECE exists to act as a countermeasure to the gender disparity within the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering at the University.

name: Women in Entrepreneurship, UW
description: We are a bold, inclusive community redefining what it means to be a student entrepreneur. We empower women across all disciplines to lead, build, and launch ventures that create real-world change.

name: Women in Finance and Accounting
description: We are an organization that targets aspiring women in business, specifically those interested in the fields of finance and accounting. In this student organization we will provide women guest speakers, community outreach, professional development, and mentorship. We aim to provide an organization that gives female students not only the confidence but also the resources they need to meet their goals and succeed. We strive to encourage inclusivity, diversity, leadership, and community involvement.

name: Women in Orthopedics
description: Three main components which are vital to the organization’s mission are to: provide for the professional development of women orthopedic professionals of diverse backgrounds; promote the advancement of musculoskeletal health and orthopedic surgery, including but not limited to, the female sex, inclusive of girls and women of diverse backgrounds; and promote the leadership of women orthopedic professionals of diverse backgrounds.

name: Women in Real Estate
description: To build a community of UW-Madison women wishing to pursue a career in real estate, and to connect these women with professionals in order to promote confidence and success in a male-dominated industry.

name: Women In Science and Engineering - Out of House
Women in Scientific Education and Research
description: WISER is a student organization aimed at connecting undergraduate women+ people in STEM fields to each other and research opportunities, while also preparing them for careers in science.

name: Women in STEM
description: Women in STEM is dedicated to creating a supportive and inclusive community for women pursuing careers in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics. We aim to empower our members through mentorship, networking, professional development, and meaningful connections with STEM peers and professionals. By fostering a welcoming environment, we strive to help women feel confident pursuing their academic and career goals in STEM.

name: Women's Affordable Housing Network at UW-Madison
description: The mission of state Women’s Affordable Housing Network (WAHN) chapters is to empower and develop women with the intention of working in the affordable housing sector through partnership, networking, allyship, advocacy, mentorship, and community engagement. We foster a supportive environment where individuals can bring their authentic selves, enabling the exchange of the brightest ideas. Driven by our collective goals, WAHN chapters work towards the establishment of a state-wide organization that brings together women from all sectors of the affordable housing industry. By uniting our expertis

name: Women's AI Studio
description: Women's AI Studio is a student organization dedicated to helping students learn artificial intelligence, regardless of their prior experience. We provide a welcoming environment where beginners can explore AI through hands-on workshops, tutorials, and collaborative projects while learning how to build AI-powered applications. By the end of each semester, members will have completed their first AI project, giving them a portfolio piece they can showcase on their resume, GitHub, or personal website. The organization also connects students with faculty, researchers, alumni, and industry professio

name: Women's Club Basketball - University of Wisconsin-Madison
description: Our mission is to provide female students with the opportunity to participate in competitive basketball throughout the school year. Through weekly practices and weekend tournaments, we wish to provide an outlet for students to develop their basketball skill sets while building relationships with teammates.

name: Women's Club Soccer (UW-Madison)
description: To provide a competitive and positive environment for those interested in playing club soccer at the University of Wisconsin-Madison.

name: Women's Club Volleyball
description: The purpose of Women’s Club Volleyball is to unite women from UW-Madison together to play at a highly competitive level against universities across the country. The Club consists of three traveling teams, one with a lesser time commitment than the other two. Our members will experience a high level of play that allows them to continue their volleyball careers with a commitment that gives members the ability to be involved in other activities around campus. To make club volleyball an affordable option for all members, we have many fundraising events that provide great support for our club. Beyo

name: Women's Club Water Polo (UW-Madison)
description: As a sports club, this organization was created to provide those interested in continuing water polo at the collegiate level with a safe and welcoming community where they could further their athletic pursuits while also forming friendships and growing leadership skills.

name: Women's Fastpitch Club Softball, University of Wisconsin-Madison
description: The mission of the Women’s Fastpitch Club Softball team is to provide student-athletes with the opportunity to compete at a high level while fostering a supportive, inclusive, and team-oriented environment. The club is committed to promoting athletic excellence, leadership, sportsmanship, and personal growth while allowing members to balance their academic, athletic, and personal responsibilities.

name: Women's Ice Hockey Club-University of Wisconsin
description: The mission of the Women’s Ice Hockey Club at UW-Madison is to provide an inclusive, supportive, and competitive environment where students of all skill levels can develop their hockey abilities, build lasting friendships, and grow as leaders both on and off the ice. The club is committed to promoting the sport of women’s hockey on the UW-Madison campus by fostering teamwork, sportsmanship, personal development, and a passion for the game while representing the University of Wisconsin with integrity, respect, and pride.

name: Women's Law Student Association
description: The mission of WLSA is to provide a forum for discussion of women’s legal issues in society; networking opportunities; academic and personal support; and to address the concerns regarding women's legal issues at the University of Wisconsin Law School.

name: Women's Rugby Football Club (UW-Madison)
description: Women’s Rugby Football Club (University of Wisconsin-Madison) plays a competitive fall season against various colleges in the Midwest and a spring season that has tournaments across the country that we attend. Between the two seasons, we have team fund raisers, training sessions, and other fun events. We strive to teach the game of rugby to interested women’s of all levels of experiences. We are a fun-loving group of girls and we want you to play rugby!

name: World Beyond War - UW Madison Chapter
WSB Leadership Lab
description: Our Leadership Lab fosters opportunities for pre-business, certificate in business, and undergraduate business students to level up their leadership skills. Whether you are just starting your leadership journey or already applying leadership skills, our program offers intentional development for all our students. We at Wisconsin School of Business build leaders who are Trusted to Lead.

name: WSB Marketing Leadership Institute
description: Connecting students with opportunities to learn, grow, and engage in the world of marketing. Stay up to date with the Marketing Leadership Institute’s latest events, networking opportunities, industry insights, and announcements designed to inspire and support the next generation of marketing leaders!

name: WSB Presenting and Writing Lab
description: The Presenting and Writing Lab builds students’ confidence in professional communication through supportive one-on-one coaching. We offer students skill-driven advice designed to help them transition from academic communicators to successful workplace communicators. Our approach is student driven; we encourage students to analyze assignments, ask critical questions, and consider their work from the audience’s perspective. Our goal is for students to leave with concrete strategies for effective professional presenting and writing.

name: WUD Art Committee
description: The Wisconsin Union Directorate Art Committee is dedicated to bringing novel and challenging exhibitions to the Wisconsin Union and advancing visual arts in the Madison community.

name: WUD Film Committee
description: The Wisconsin Union Directorate Film Committee is a student-run organization dedicated to bringing a diverse, innovative, and exciting lineup of movies to the University of Wisconsin – Madison campus and surrounding community.

name: WUD Games Committee
description: The mission of WUD Games is to provide a fun and welcoming environment through the use of games and the gaming community.

name: WUD Global Connections
description: The Wisconsin Union Directorate Global Connections Committee is a fun and engaging organization open to any UW student. We strive to foster awareness of global issues and interests in various cultures and strive to close the understanding gap between people of different cultures and identities through our various programs. WUD Global Connections offers the opportunity to build long-lasting friendships and connections on campus (and beyond!), as we bridge the gap between domestic and international members of our campus community. The Global Connections Committee is open to all UW-Madison studen

name: WUD Literary Arts Committee
description: The Wisconsin Union Directorate Literary Arts Committee (WUD Lit) is dedicated to building community through the Literary Arts on the UW-Madison campus. We provide hands-on experience in publishing and in hosting events focused on engaging with the literary arts. We publish three student-run magazines—EMMIE, Illumination, and The Dish—highlighting the creativity of the UW-Madison community. Their content focuses on music, food journalism, and creative works of poetry, art, and prose

name: WUD Music
description: WUD Music presents high quality and diverse programming to promote artistic interaction and inclusivity at The University of Wisconsin-Madison. We aim to entertain, enlighten, and strengthen the community through music and live performance.

name: WUD Volunteer Action Committee
description: The Wisconsin Union Directorate Volunteer Action Committee is centered on creating meaningful ethical volunteer opportunities right here on campus. Through pop-up events and hands-on projects, students can make an immediate impact in their community while building connections and learning through teamwork.
